title: Pay bills from linked suppliers after one approval
summary: Every week on the day you choose, each bill from your suppliers on Taskiem is sent to be paid after one approval, up to an amount; bigger ones are held for you.
description: On the day and time you choose, Taskiem looks at the bills your suppliers on Taskiem sent you that are due within the week or overdue (or only one supplier's, if you name it). Each bill up to the amount you set goes to your bill payments: the person who approves payments sees the name on the supplier's account and approves it once, and the transfer goes from your own payments account, carrying the bill's reference so the supplier's Taskiem counts it. Bigger bills, queried bills and bills with no account to pay into are held, and you are told which. Set up paying bills on the Bills page first.

params.name: pay_day
params.title: Day
params.description: The day of the week bills are paid.

params.name: pay_time
params.title: Time
params.description: When the bills are sent for approval, Lagos time.

params.name: supplier
params.title: Only this supplier
params.description: A supplier's name on Taskiem, to pay only their bills. Leave it blank for every linked supplier.

params.name: max_naira
params.title: Up to (naira)
params.description: Bills above this amount are held for you to pay yourself.

definition.name: Pay bills from linked suppliers
definition.description: Sends each bill due from linked suppliers, up to an amount, to be paid after one approval; holds the rest.

steps.name: Send each bill to be paid

input.title: Bills to pay
input.message: =(size(steps.pay.output.filter(o, !has(o.not_paid))) > 0 ? 'Waiting for approval: ' + steps.pay.output.filter(o, !has(o.not_paid)).map(o, o.pay_one.reference).join(', ') + '. ' : '') + (size(steps.bills.output.bills.filter(b, !b.payable || double(b.due_kobo) > double({{max_naira}}) * 100.0)) + size(steps.pay.output.filter(o, has(o.not_paid))) > 0 ? 'Held for you: ' + (steps.bills.output.bills.filter(b, !b.payable || double(b.due_kobo) > double({{max_naira}}) * 100.0).map(b, b.reference + ' from ' + b.business) + steps.pay.output.filter(o, has(o.not_paid)).map(o, o.not_paid.reference)).join(', ') + ' (see Bills).' : '')
